title: Ostriches Sprint at 45 mph and Cannot Even Fly

scenes.text: This bird that cannot fly runs 45 miles an hour.
It is the ostrich, and Guinness World Records calls it the fastest flightless bird on land.
That is about seventy-two kilometres an hour.
Over longer distances it can hold around thirty-one miles an hour.
Chicks reach thirty-five miles an hour within a few weeks of hatching.
No flight. Just legs that can outrun city traffic.

description:
